contact_filter: one geom in a named hand region and the other body in the task object-body allowlist

force_frame.canonical_tangential: Euclidean magnitude; contact-local tangent axes are not treated as stable world axes
force_frame.geom_order_invariance: positive normal and tangential magnitude make the canonical scalar features independent of hand/object geom ordering

aggregation.occupancy: 1 if any matched contact has positive normal force, else 0

normalization: raw physical values only; final learning normalization is deferred to S4.2 train split
impulse: diagnostic force_integral = force * control_dt; not part of the canonical vector
claim: physics-derived Contact proxy, not an electronic or taxel-level RH56DFTP simulation
